LEAD TIME
Approx 15 Day Atelier Process
Each piece is made from full-grain leather sourced from tanneries certified Gold by the Leather Working Group (LWG). The textured surface gives the color greater depth and keeps the silhouette clearly defined. Each piece is made by leather artisans with more than ten years of experience, using carefully selected thread for the stitching. The process requires time and focus. Specially selected edge paint is applied in thin layers. Each layer is dried and sanded before the next is applied. This creates a thin, natural-looking protective layer that resists cracking and peeling while retaining the texture of the leather.

CRAFT
THE RHYTHM OF MAKING

Each piece follows a measured process of cutting, stitching, and finishing.

Over 15 days, the leather is shaped with close attention to material, structure, and detail.

DAY 01-03
Leather Selection & Cutting
Texture often says more than words. Full-grain leather is sourced from tanneries certified Gold by the Leather Working Group (LWG). Heavy surface coatings are avoided, preserving the leather’s natural grain, supple texture, and individual character. Each hide is carefully selected and precisely cut so the panels come together in a balanced, consistent composition.
DAY 04-08
Thread Selection & Stitching
Each well-placed stitch gives the form its strength. Selected to meet exacting standards for texture, strength, flexibility, and finish, the thread gives each seam a clean, precise expression. Carefully controlled spacing and tension support the bag’s structure while refining its overall feel.
DAY 09-13
Edge Paint & Finishing
Refinement is visible in every edge. Specially selected edge paint creates a fine, subtly textured finish with a light and refined appearance. Built up in multiple thin layers, it gives the edges quiet depth without making them feel heavy. Its flexibility and adhesion allow the finish to sit naturally with the leather, adding definition to the silhouette and detail of the bag.
DAY 14-15+
Final Quality Inspection
Nothing is finished until every detail is in place. Before packaging, every bag is reviewed for silhouette, panel alignment, stitch consistency, edge finish, leather condition, and hardware function. Only pieces that meet the required standards are approved for release.
